tools.description: Look up one marketing or data tool (for example Snowflake, Braze, Google Ads or The Trade Desk) in CdpHub's directory: how many of the customer data platforms (CDPs) it tracks list an integration with it, each CDP counted once (both sends data to it and reads from it, only sends, only reads), which

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Check a stack of two to ten tools against every CDP in CdpHub's directory, as the stack check on cdphub.com does: how many CDPs list all of them and which, those CDPs grouped by how they connect to each tool with each group counted, the CDPs that miss exactly one tool grouped by the tool they miss,

tools.name: compare_cdps
tools.description: Compare two CDPs' integration catalogs in CdpHub's directory, tool by tool: how many tools both list, how many only one does, the most widely listed tools in both, each side's largest categories of tools the other lacks, and the link to their comparison page on cdphub.com.

tools.name: get_cdp
tools.description: Look up one customer data platform's integration catalog in CdpHub's directory: its number of tools and listings and its rank by catalog size, which way its integrations run, its largest categories with their most widely listed tools, how it connects to the main data warehouses, the CDPs that list t

tools.name: list_cdps
tools.description: List every customer data platform in CdpHub's directory with its number of tools and listings and its page on cdphub.com, largest catalog first, with the directory's totals.

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search CdpHub's directory of CDP integrations by keyword, CDP, category, direction or how the integration runs. Returns the exact totals, the first results and the link to the same search on cdphub.com. Use get_tool for one named tool and check_stack for several.
